title: 第625章 莫问天身份藏不了多久第624章 夜洐入轮回殿我一人担之
slug: 从天牢走出的魔尊她们怕了
content_zh:
第625章莫问天身份，藏不了多久
轮回殿主魔眼凝重，重重落在夜洐身上。
他无法理解，夜洐凭什么这般张狂。
他最大的靠山，不就是本殿的生死轮回殿吗？
轮回殿主郑重警示：“你可知她身份修为？那是半步教主境的人物，护身至宝无数，底蕴深不可测，即便本殿亲自出手，也难以将其快速镇压拿下，一旦动手，便会立即惊动姜家的老怪物们。”
“且本殿与神女有过协议，尊者之上不得擅自下场，此协议对你最为有利，若无尊者之上人物介入，她近乎无敌。”
“就算有妹妹倾力相助，你可拿下慕容幽，可面对这位大瑞朝长公主，对付慕容幽的手段毫无用处，你究竟有何底气，敢出此狂言？”
轮回殿主期待夜洐的回答。
比本殿还狂。
“事已密成，此事天机不可泄露。”夜洐残魂神秘道。
此事牵扯重大，更关乎夜洐第二道身份“莫问天”，无法明说。
何况这道与本体彻底分离的魂体，本就剥离了夜洐本体核心记忆，无任何关于莫问天的记忆，魂体就算想暴露，也无法暴露。
“本殿如何信你？”轮回殿主始终想不通，夜洐如何才能做到。
“不需要你信，你只需看着，不会太久。”
“狂.....”轮回殿主起身，负手而立，两道震慑天地的寒芒破瞳而，周身虚空出现细碎裂痕，一股恐怖气势正在酝酿。
正要让这个不知天高地厚的小子，好好感受一番，何为教主境的可怖，要碾碎他肆无忌惮的张狂，免得之后又连累妹妹遭遇危险。
“兄长！”
一声冰冷带着生气的声音，从厉邪姒红唇发出，强势打断漫天威势。
厉邪姒蓦然回眸，异色双眸此时覆满寒霜，不满看着自己的兄长。
轮回殿主从未在自己妹妹眼中，看到过这般凌厉生气的样子。

刹那间，轮回殿主周身即将喷涌而出的恐怖气势骤然一滞。
轮回殿主内心一时气结，本殿这是为了这小子好，让他知道教主境的可怕，免得这般天高地厚。
但在厉邪姒越发不满的直视下，威震天下的轮回殿主，被迫压下心底所有的想法与郁结，不悦的扫了一眼被妹妹稳稳护在身后的残魂小子。
轮回殿主心头怒火未平，更让他郁气更盛一点，看到那不成器的逆子，居然一脸谄媚凑到夜洐面前。
厉自在一溜烟凑到夜洐眼前，满脸堆笑，眼神热切，讨好的央求道：“哥、哥、哥......带上我，这一次你一定要带上我。”
这些时日，厉自在受过了没人瞩目的黯淡时光。
哪怕仗着修为背景，四处嚣张跋扈，可无论怎么造势，风头总是差点。
任凭自己拼尽全力，可怎么也比不了夜洐随手一挥，甚至连莫问天仅仅出世风头就完全盖过自己。
这怎么能成？
厉自在此时认清现实，单凭自己难以掀起震动天下的风浪，唯有跟在夜洐身边一起干大事，才会万众瞩目。

Chapter 625: Mo Wentian’s identity cannot be hidden for long
The evil eye of the Lord of Samsara Palace fell heavily on Ye Hui.
He couldn't understand why Ye Hui was so arrogant.
Isn't his biggest backer the Palace of Reincarnation of Life and Death in this palace?
The Master of the Samsara Palace solemnly warned: "Do you know her identity and cultivation? She is a person in the half-step leader realm, with countless protective treasures, and her background is unfathomable. Even if we personally take action, it will be difficult to suppress her quickly. Once we do it, the old monsters of the Jiang family will be alerted immediately."
"Furthermore, this temple has an agreement with the goddess, and no one above her will be allowed to leave without permission. This agreement is most beneficial to you. If no one above her lord intervenes, she will be almost invincible."
"Even if you have my sister's full help, you can take down Murong You, but in the face of the eldest princess of the Darui Dynasty, the methods you use to deal with Murong You are useless. What confidence do you have to dare to make such arrogant remarks?"
The Lord of Samsara Hall was looking forward to Ye Hui's answer.
Even crazier than me.
"The matter has been sealed, and the secret of this matter must not be leaked." Ye Hui's remnant soul said mysteriously.
This matter involves a lot, and it is also related to Ye Hui's second identity "Mo Wentian", which cannot be explained clearly.
What's more, this soul body that is completely separated from the main body has stripped away the core memory of Ye Hui's body and has no memory of Mo Wentian. Even if the soul body wants to be exposed, it cannot be exposed.
"How can I trust you?" The master of Samsara Palace still couldn't figure out how Ye Hu could do it.
"You don't need to believe it. You just have to watch. It won't be long."
"Crazy..." The Lord of Samsara Hall stood up and stood with his hands behind his back. Two cold rays of light that shocked the world shot out of his eyes. Fine cracks appeared in the void around him, and a terrifying aura was brewing.
I want to let this ignorant boy have a good feel for the horror of the leader realm, and I want to crush his unbridled arrogance, so as not to put my sister in danger later.
"Brother!"
A cold and angry voice came from Li Xiesi's red lips, interrupting the overwhelming power in the sky.
Li Xiesi suddenly looked back, her strange-colored eyes covered with frost, looking at her brother dissatisfied.
The Master of Samsara Hall has never seen such a fierce and angry look in his sister's eyes.
In an instant, the terrifying aura that was about to burst out from the Master of Samsara Hall suddenly stopped.
The Master of Samsara Palace felt angry for a moment. This palace is doing this for the good of this boy, letting him know how terrifying the leader realm is, so that he can avoid being so arrogant.
But under Li Xiesi's increasingly dissatisfied gaze, the world-famous Master of Samsara Palace was forced to suppress all the thoughts and frustrations in his heart, and glanced displeased at the boy who was being guarded behind him by his sister.
The anger in Samsara Hall Master's heart was not subsided, which made him even more depressed. When he saw the incompetent traitor, he actually approached Ye Wei with a flattering look on his face.
Li Zi walked up to Ye Hui in a flash, with a smile on his face and eager eyes. He begged to please: "Brother, brother, brother... take me with you. You must take me with you this time."
During these days, Li Zizai experienced a bleak time when no one noticed him.
Even though he is arrogant and domineering due to his cultivation background, no matter how he builds momentum, he always falls short of the limelight.
No matter how hard he tried, he couldn't compare to Ye Tao's casual wave. Even Mo Wentian's mere appearance in the limelight completely overshadowed his own.
How can this be done?
At this time, Li Zizai realized the reality. It was difficult for him to make waves that would shock the world by himself. Only by doing big things with Ye Wei would he attract everyone's attention.
